request.task: T1 exact Fable 5 initial full-section Canvas Agent Studio audit evidence
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

findings.scenario: A consumer treats this artifact as proof that claude-fable-5 audited the entire selected spec section 'docs/specs/2026-08-29-ai-teammate-foundation-v1.md — Local Canvas and API surface' and every integrationBoundary clause. The file only stores a section title, seven boundary phrases, eight implementation findings, and a keep-list. There is no requirement inventory, inspected-symbol map, or per-boundary result (finding id / no-finding / out-of-scope), so unread subsections and unaudited boundary clauses are indistinguishable from audited-clean ones.
findings.remediation: Add a closed coverage table for every selected-section requirement and each integrationBoundary clause, binding each row to the file/symbol inspected and to a finding id or explicit no-finding; do not claim completeness until that table is populated.

findings.scenario: The criterion requires distinguishing underreach, overreach, duplication, authority drift, and deferred scope. Only overreach is a named assessment. Every finding.authorityDisposition is the same 'inside-current-scope' token, and deferred/out-of-slice items are mixed into residualRisksNotAcceptedAsCurrentCorrections and proofGaps. If the Fable driver had underreach, duplication, or authority-drift results, dropping them would be silent.
findings.remediation: Add explicit underreachAssessment, duplicationAssessment, authorityDriftAssessment, and deferredScopeAssessment fields. Write 'none observed' only when that was the driver's result; never encode absence by omitting the key.

findings.scenario: requestedModel, reportedModel, and canonicalModel all say claude-fable-5 with fallback none, but the slice has no runtime model string, ordered read/tool log, or hash of the selected section at target.commit. proofGaps already admit the run executed no test, typecheck, build, or E2E. The driver block is therefore self-attestation and cannot detect a different model, a partial file set, or a reconstructed write-up.
findings.remediation: Bind the driver to checkable proof: runtime model id, the existing session identifiers, ordered paths/sections read, and a content hash of the selected spec section at target.commit.

findings.scenario: proofGaps state F-01 incidence was alphabet-derived, F-04 reachability was computed not executed, and F-08 focus behavior was inferred, yet those items remain in findings[] at HIGH/MEDIUM with no per-finding evidenceGrade. A later correction pass can treat unverified static inference as deterministic proof of product defects.
findings.remediation: Attach evidenceGrade (observed|computed|inferred) and the matching proofGaps id on each finding; keep severity but do not present unexecuted claims as equivalent to measured failures.

findings.scenario: F-07 cites src/components/preview/AiTeammate/AiTeammatePanel.test.tsx line 1 for a whole-file keyboard/E2E oracle gap, so the missing keyboard.press/focus/busy-lock assertion cannot be located or re-verified.
findings.remediation: Cite the specific describe/it/helper and the Canvas E2E symbol that lack a real keyboard path, or mark the finding as file-scoped explicitly.

audit.proof_assessment: The artifact is advisory under OBX-AUTH-ATF-001, names claude-fable-5 with no fallback, keeps an eight-finding list plus proofGaps, and does not authorize implementation or release. It does not truthfully prove an exact Fable 5 driver completed the selected section and integration boundary: there is no section/boundary coverage map, no files-read binding, and no first-class underreach, duplication, authority-drift, or deferred-scope results. Several HIGH/MEDIUM items are disclosed as unexecuted inference, so they are preserved claims, not deterministic proof.
residual_risks: Original Fable transcript is not in the slice, so dropped or rewritten findings cannot be detected
Application line citations cannot be checked from this docs-only slice
target.tree is not proven against target.commit in-slice
Static unexecuted review may have missed runtime authorization, lifecycle, and oracle defects on the live Canvas Agent Studio surface
